issues.desc: background.md (Trigger Event / Key Insights / Solution Tradeoffs sections, returned verbatim by background_get) uses several jargon/mechanism terms with zero definition anywhere in the required-reading set: repro-first intake, story_create_from_repro, probe (as an artifact type), red-reviewed, target-bug classification, and Authority proof. Grep of CLAUDE.md (mandatory first required-reading file) confirms none of these terms appear there, so a fresh reader relying only on the required reading list cannot infer what a probe is, what red-reviewed/target-bug mean, or what Authority proof refers to. This mechanism is documented only in packages/main/src/core/repro-intake.ts, which is outside the reviewers required-reading scope. This issue persists unchanged from the prior review round because background.md is generated verbatim by story_create_from_repro and is not editable through the CLI.

background.md Trigger Event section cites artifact IDs "Probe rp-mtk45qx1-nj8w3o" and "review rr-mtk4a0j3-age5w9" as cross-references but the background.md text itself gives no one-sentence explanation of what they are or where/how to inspect them (no file path, no CLI lookup command such as evidence_inspect mentioned in the text). This fails the standalone-readability cross-reference standard (compare the CLAUDE.md convention of one-sentence context on first appearance for a cross-story reference like B-45ed F-002). This issue persists unchanged from the prior review round because background.md is generated verbatim by story_create_from_repro and is not editable through the CLI.
